pdf.body:
<#if record.item?has_content>


    <#assign groupedItems = {}>

    
    <#list record.item as item>

        <#assign groupKey = item.custcol_item_id?string + "_" + item.description?string + "_" + item.rate?string>

        <#if groupedItems[groupKey]??>

            <#assign existing = groupedItems[groupKey]>

            
            <#if item.requesteddate?has_content>
                <#assign dateKey = item.requesteddate?string("yyyy-MM-dd")>

                <#if existing.dates[dateKey]??>
                    <#assign dateQty = existing.dates[dateKey] + item.quantity>
                <#else>
                    <#assign dateQty = item.quantity>
                </#if>

                <#assign updatedDates = existing.dates + {
                    dateKey: dateQty
                }>
            <#else>
                <#assign updatedDates = existing.dates>
            </#if>

            
            <#assign groupedItems = groupedItems + {
                groupKey: {
                    "item": existing.item,
                    "description": existing.description,
                    "rate": existing.rate,
                    "quantity": existing.quantity + item.quantity,
                    "amount": existing.amount + item.amount,
                    "dates": updatedDates
                }
            }>

        <#else>

            
            <#assign dates = {}>

            <#if item.requesteddate?has_content>
                <#assign dateKey = item.requesteddate?string("yyyy-MM-dd")>

                <#assign dates = dates + {
                    dateKey: item.quantity
                }>
            </#if>

            <#assign groupedItems = groupedItems + {
                groupKey: {
                    "item": item.custcol_item_id,
                    "description": item.description,
                    "rate": item.rate,
                    "quantity": item.quantity,
                    "amount": item.amount,
                    "dates": dates
                }
            }>

        </#if>

    </#list>


    
    
        

            
                Line
            

            
                Quantity Ordered
            

            
                Item No.
            

            
                Description
            

            
                Unit Price
            

            
                Extended
            
        
    


    
    <#assign counter = 1>

    <#list groupedItems?keys as key>

        <#assign grouped = groupedItems[key]>

        


            
                ${counter}
            

            
                ${grouped.quantity}
            

            
                ${grouped.item}
            

            
            

                ${grouped.description}

                <#if grouped.dates?size gt 0>

                    

                        

                            
                                Date Wanted
                            

                            
                                Quantity
                            
                        

                        
                        <#list grouped.dates?keys?sort as dateKey>

                            

                                
                                    ${dateKey?date("yyyy-MM-dd")?string("MMM dd, yyyy")}
                                

                                
                                    ${grouped.dates[dateKey]}
                                
                            

                        </#list>

                    

                </#if>

            

            
                ${grouped.rate}
            

            
                ${grouped.amount}
            

        

        <#assign counter = counter + 1>

    </#list>


          ${record.custbody_nsps_item_num_and_expiration_}
    
    </#if>
    
        

            
            ${record.subtotal@label}
            ${record.subtotal}
        
        

            
            ${record.taxtotal@label} (${record.taxrate}%)
            ${record.taxtotal}
        
        

            
            ${record.total@label}
            ${record.total}
        
    


               
        


          Notes/ Remarques
                 

                      ${record.custbody_im_customer_comments}
